terminology_note: The categories are EF-based functional bands for an assistive, non-diagnostic research system. They are not used as standalone heart-failure diagnoses.
class_balance_decision: No resampling, SMOTE, or other synthetic balancing is introduced at target-definition stage because all three classes have substantial representation and the training distribution is approximately balanced.
split_policy: Original patient-level 400/50/50 split with seed 42 is retained.
test_policy: The test partition is not used for classifier selection, feature selection, hyperparameter selection, threshold adjustment, or calibration.
historical_test_note: The test partition had historical pilot exposure before the clean rebuild and is therefore not described as a pristine external test set.
